custody_policy: Secret values remain outside the public repository. This registry stores only non-secret binding metadata and provider expectations.

bindings.required_capability: GitHub Projects v2 create/read/write for the crownthrive1 user-owned project plus repository Issues/Pull Requests access required by PentaPM
bindings.fallback_limit: PentaPM must fail closed for Projects v2 when the dedicated rotated credential is unavailable. Repository GITHUB_TOKEN is not authoritative for user-owned Projects v2 creation.
bindings.exposure_policy: Never commit, log, print, echo, serialize, or place token values in source, issues, receipts, artifacts, or chat-derived records.
bindings.rotation_policy: Any credential value exposed outside an approved secret boundary is immediately non-authoritative and must be revoked and replaced before runtime use.
bindings.verification_policy: Provider readback must prove the rotated credential has Projects v2 authority before PentaPM clears projects_v2_provider_authority HOLD.
